I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot because one bag costs too much and is more than I need for 0.29 hectares, so I will spread cow manure from my compound instead. I will plant the local beans I saved from last season and pull weeds by hand with my children, and if insects come I will pick them off without buying any spray. I will not hire anyone because there is no extra cash for wages, and I will not irrigate because there is no river or pump nearby. I am relying only on the rain God sends us this year.
